name: CI/CD to Local IIS

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: self-hosted

    steps:
      # ---------------- Checkout Repo ----------------
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # ---------------- Setup .NET ----------------
      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: 6.0.x

      # ---------------- Build Backend ----------------
      - name: Build Backend
        run: |
          dotnet restore "${{ github.workspace }}\Selise.SeniorBackEndDev.Assessment.sln"
          dotnet publish "${{ github.workspace }}\Selise.SeniorBackEndDev.Assessment.sln" -c Release -o "${{ github.workspace }}\publish-api"

      # ---------------- Deploy to IIS ----------------
      - name: Deploy to IIS
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Path to deployment script in repo
          $deployScript = "${{ github.workspace }}\deploy.ps1"

          # Run deploy.ps1
          & $deployScript -sourcePath "${{ github.workspace }}\publish-api" -destinationPath "C:\inetpub\wwwroot\MyApp"
